name: Monster Energy
note: Title sponsor of Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP since 2019; team title sponsor confirmed for 2026 at the Jakarta launch (Yamaha Motor race release, 2026-01-22). Monster Energy is the brand of Monster Beverage Corporation (Nasdaq: MNST); Coca-Cola held about 20.9% as of 13 Feb 2026 per the FY2025 10-K. No state or fund owner.
